mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for 20d returns < 0.03 when FEDFUNDS shows a sustained downward trend, or returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 3.5% triggers a contraction in consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.3 percentage points in the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 3.5%, or p-value for t-test >0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and business investment (HOUST) signals robust demand, amplifying corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both GDPC1 and HOUST show upward trends, or returns not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer spending (RSAFS) both indicate expanding supply and demand, creating a virtuous cycle that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window when both INDPRO and RSAFS rise, or returns not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE <3%) and ultra-low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS <2%) create a favorable environment for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods when UNRATE <3% and FEDFUNDS <2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in personal consumption (GDPC1) over the next quarter signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when GDPC1 shows sustained upward movement, or returns not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%, or p-value for t-test >0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in personal consumption (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) reflects a robust demand-supply cycle, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise, or returns not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05).
